name: Jaipur
shortDescription: Explore royal palaces, historic forts and the colourful Pink City.
description: Jaipur, the Pink City of India, is famous for its royal heritage, magnificent forts, beautiful palaces and vibrant markets.

name: Kerala
shortDescription: Experience peaceful backwaters, green tea gardens and beautiful nature.
description: Kerala is known as God's Own Country. Enjoy houseboat cruises, hill stations, beaches and beautiful landscapes.

name: Goa
shortDescription: Enjoy beautiful beaches, water sports, nightlife and Portuguese heritage.
description: Goa is a popular holiday destination famous for its beaches, nightlife, seafood, churches and Portuguese architecture.

name: Ladakh
shortDescription: Discover high mountain passes, peaceful monasteries and beautiful lakes.
description: Ladakh offers breathtaking mountain landscapes, adventure activities, Buddhist monasteries and unforgettable road trips.

name: Manali
shortDescription: Enjoy snow-covered mountains, adventure sports and beautiful valleys.
description: Manali is a beautiful hill station offering mountain views, adventure sports, peaceful temples and scenic landscapes.

name: Munnar
shortDescription: Relax among beautiful tea gardens, misty hills and waterfalls.
description: Munnar is a peaceful hill station famous for tea plantations, green valleys, pleasant weather and scenic viewpoints.

name: Bali
shortDescription: Explore tropical beaches, beautiful temples and stunning rice terraces.
description: Bali is a tropical island destination known for its beaches, cultural attractions, temples, rice terraces and natural beauty.

name: Paris
shortDescription: Discover iconic landmarks, museums, beautiful streets and French culture.
description: Paris is one of the world's most popular travel destinations, famous for its architecture, art, museums, fashion and cuisine.
